meetings.title: 11th Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, the committee discussed the issue of the damage caused to the microphone and its base in Committee Room 5, during the meeting of Committee on Independent Institutions. As proposed by Milandhoo Constituency member Hassan Mufeed Abdul Gadir and seconded by Makunudhoo Constituency member Adam Shafeeq, the committee decided that members' negligence, which caused damage to the microphone, violated the code of conduct for parliament members outlined in Article 70(c) of the Standing Order, and that the cost of the damage to the microphone should be deducted from their salaries in accordance with Article 71(a)(5) of the Standing Order. The committee discussed the issue of the damage caused to the microphone during the 10th Parliament Sitting of third session of 2025 held on 22 October 2025. As proposed by Milandhoo Constituency member Hassan Mufeed Abdul Gadir and seconded by Makunudhoo Constituency member Adam Shafeeq, the committee decided that the member’s behavior which caused damage to the microphone, violated the code of conduct for parliament members outlined in Article 70(c) of the Standing Order, and that the cost of the damage to the microphone should be deducted from the member's salary in accordance with Article 71(a)(5) of the Standing Order.
